title: SayanPack
description: A developer made modpack based on Fabulously Optimized pack.
body: This modpack was created for developers who want a ready-to-use Minecraft instance with some extra features and tweaks. While Fabulously Optimized is a great starting point, it was missing a few things I personally needed. This pack includes tweaks to existing mods, like Dynamic FPS, and adds handy extras like ViaVersion. It also comes with additional resources, including shaderpacks and resource packs, to enhance your experience.
